interface.longDescription: ForgeMind, published by Aivana GmbH, turns a new or existing app into a ranked innovation portfolio with evidence, moat, monetization hypotheses, MVP experiments, and kill conditions, then moves the selected bet into market-tested delivery with verifiable release proof. Aivana's public product focus on AI-supported work organization, tracking, and sharing informs the product context; ForgeMind remains a local-first Codex plugin.
